reviewType: Bounded AI-assisted public-source wording and structure comparison; not legal clearance, human-independent certification or psychometric validation
method: Inspect all five current stems/categories and main/three optional story prompts.
Compare inspected primary-source item wording, response formats and conceptual structure; identify closest comparators by item identifiers without publishing their text.
Check quoted full-stem web searches as a secondary cross-check. Returned broadened unrelated results are not proof of an exact negative search.
Use only public pages/author-hosted PDFs; record failed or limited access. No login/paywall bypass, purchase, provider contact or credentials.

sources.inspected: Nine named sample items on the official CIS-S page, all displayed dimensions, and assessment access links.
sources.finding: No matching full stem among displayed samples; concepts of interest and career awareness overlap.
sources.uninspected: Complete current age/grade-specific CIS-S forms and hidden item pool; public page offers samples/contact/client portal, not full forms. No credentials requested.
sources.neededIfFullComparisonRequired: A lawfully obtained complete form/version with permission for confidential comparison, or written provider confirmation. No item bank should be published.

sources.reference: OECD (2021), Indicators of teenage career readiness: Guidance for policy makers
sources.inspected: Policy brief Table1, indicator definitions and Box10 (14 school-guidance questions, p22), through public web PDF text.
sources.finding: This is an indicator/policy synthesis, not a five-item source instrument. No matching AltWing stem identified.
sources.uninspected: All underlying national longitudinal questionnaires and PISA forms, translations, historical revisions; these are outside this bounded reference review.

sources.inspected: Official performance-expectation page: design practices, criteria/constraints and trade-off considerations.
sources.finding: Q2 shares the trade-off concept, not an identified questionnaire item. A standard is not an attitude survey or validation of Q2.

sources.inspected: Public publisher article and indexed Table1: all24 stems, sel1–3/inf1–3/opp1–3/goa1–3/dec1–3/act1–3/ref1–3/con1–3.
sources.finding: Q3 relates conceptually to sel1/sel3; Q5 to con1; Q2 to dec3. No matching full stem or distinctive near-copy identified.
sources.accessLimit: Publisher retrieval was intermittent. Table1 was readable through publisher-indexed public text; university-repository PDF returned403 and was not bypassed.
sources.uninspected: Any separate current administration form, revisions, translations or unpublished items, beyond published Table1.

items.closestComparators: OECD exploration/experience indicators; CEDS opportunity awareness.
items.finding: Different operationalization: a prior-experience count, not agreement about awareness or attitudes. No full-stem match in inspected materials.
items.residual: Uninspected current CIS-S/STEM revisions cannot be cleared.

items.closestComparators: NGSS trade-off criteria; CEDS dec3; Activation scientific-sensemaking performance tasks.
items.finding: Conceptual similarity; a retrospective mission-frequency question differs from career-choice agreement and science performance tasks.
items.residual: Shared common decision language is not proof of copying or of originality.

items.meaning: Perceived help discovering enjoyable engineering work
items.finding: Similar construct, distinct experience-specific help question. No matching distinctive wording identified.

items.meaning: Retrospective change in interest beyond assignments
items.closestComparators: Activation Fascination f1–f8; PEAR engagement/enjoyment samples.
items.finding: Retrospective school-independent change differs from standing preferences; common interest vocabulary alone is not an identified copied item.
items.residual: Any later/current unpublished activation or CIS-S item remains unverified.

items.finding: Conceptual next-step overlap, but specific possible-activity clarity differs from general career-planning agreement. No distinctive near-copy identified.
items.residual: Not a copyrightability ruling; future source evidence could change the finding.

items.dimension: Beyond the Flight main prompt and three optional reflections
items.meaning: Specific event, meaning, optional change and next action
items.closestComparators: MSC story elicitation pp23–26/sample p97; CEDS reflection constructs.
items.finding: Acknowledged method-level event/significance/future structure; present phrasing and neutral no-change invitation differ. No long distinctive wording match identified.
items.residual: Whether a particular use is a legally derivative adaptation is not adjudicated. Do not copy guide forms without reviewing its license.

responseCategories.finding: Frequency/intensity/clarity and less/same/more categories are common formats; no distinctive source item/category package reproduced. This is not a legal conclusion that every short label is unprotectable.

actionRequired: Retain conceptual references and accurate AI-generated provenance; never label the custom questionnaire validated, endorsed, guaranteed original or licensed from referenced institutions.
Acknowledge full/current unavailable forms explicitly; obtain lawfully supplied forms/provider confirmation only if full-form clearance is required or concrete overlap evidence emerges.

If distinctive protected expression is identified later, pause its publication and obtain adequate permission or independently revise with a new wording/version review. No compulsory wording change is justified by the present evidence.
Do not apply the MSC guide license or any source-instrument license to AltWing proprietary code merely because concepts were cited.
scopeNote: This completed review covers the exact archived impact-v2 wording. impact-v3 is a later documented plain-language usability revision; this historical review is not relabelled as a new instrument comparison or originality guarantee.
